CP6.name: Pro Forma Modeling Engine + Outcome Reports — Algoma Parity
CP6.notes: Development cost/revenue/NOI/IRR/equity-multiple engine, sibling to hbu-engine.ts. IRR/NPV via financial npm package (numpy-financial port) — no hand-rolled finance math. Hard cost $/sf table is a starting assumption anchored to hbu-engine.ts, explicitly labeled as such everywhere it renders. RENTAL/FOR_SALE deal types both refuse to compute without a manually-supplied comp (monthlyRentPerUnit / avgSalePricePerUnit) — never fabricates rent/sale comps. rent_comps and proforma_scenarios tables already existed in migrations/20260218_add_feasibility_tables.sql (unused by this engine — DB persistence of scenarios is a follow-up, not in scope here). PDF export is client-side jsPDF (already a dependency, same pattern as FloorPlanStudio), drawn directly with jsPDF's text/rect/image primitives rather than via svg2pdf since there is no SVG source to convert. Visually verified: rendered a real downloaded PDF to PNG via poppler pdftoppm and read it.
